build_NormalDistribution: build a univariate normal log density with configurable location and scale parameters
build_MultivariateNormalDistribution: build a multivariate normal log density with shared mean and diagonal covariance
build_FunnelDistribution: build a 10-dimensional funnel distribution log density for sampling benchmarks
build_PhiFourTheory: build a phi-four field theory log density on a 2D lattice with mass and coupling parameters
build_ManyWell: build a many-well log density with paired dimensions for flow-based model testing
